recap.text: Brandon and his brother Chris, the facility's maintenance guys, spend almost five hours building Carl's idea from looted goblin tools: workshop tables on weight-equipment legs, weight benches bolted on like shutters, a roof of weight-rack cross bars. With Agatha and her shopping cart inside, no room remains for the centre pole, and the ball's hit slides the Speedbump with a screech. They stab up through the lattice until the boss bursts like a balloon.

Donut will not wake, and Signet says she will stay where she is. Carl lifts her anyway, a health bar appears and starts to fall, and Signet warns that a water lily must not be removed, lest it die, so he sets her back. He pulls the last redoubt pieces, wood and metal, from his inventory and throws up an ugly, quick pyramid around her chair. Mongo jumps to the top and looks down through the jagged hole.

beats.headline: Almost five hours of building
beats.text: Brandon and his brother Chris are the facility's maintenance guys. Carl describes his idea, spreads out the looted goblin tools, and they go straight to work. It takes almost five hours to build the pieces of a portable, modular fortress: workshop tables on new legs from the weight equipment, weight benches bolted on like shutters, a roof of weight-rack cross bars, barbell poles to brace it. Brandon calls it the Speedbump. They practise until the main structure goes up in less than twenty seconds and the rest in twenty more. Fifty of Carl's shuriken go into the front table's wooden covering as spikes; only about twenty stay unbroken.
beats.gist: Brandon and Chris build the Speedbump fortress from weight benches and workshop tables.

beats.headline: Wedged under the ball
beats.text: On a fifteen-foot square of floor with no grooves, they build it in the order they practised while Agatha wails about her shopping cart, which Carl has just put into his inventory. With her inside, there is no room for the final, centre pole. The ball hits. The structure slides with a horrifying screech, all four ceiling braces pop out, and one throws Yolanda over. The ball is wedged between the roof and the tunnel, the roof sagging. They stab up through the lattice until, as the top collapses, the boss bursts like a balloon and tuxedoed tusklings rain down on them.
beats.gist: Donut and Carl build a fortress around Agatha, but the ball wedges it and the boss bursts.

beats.headline: Edited out from under it
beats.text: The recap episode shows them huddled underneath the redoubt as Donut screams that it's coming. Brandon's older brother, Chris, speaks up, only the second time Carl has heard him, and says there is more to it. Agatha was edited out of the scene. She was next to him under the speedbump, but she wasn't there when they showed it. Oh yeah, says Brandon. Weird.
beats.gist: Brandon's brother Chris tells Carl the recap edited Agatha out, though she huddled beside him under the speedbump.

beats.headline: A shield in the corner
beats.text: Krakaren's tentacles are smashing through the walls and Carl is buzzed on his own smoothie. Running for the back corner of the room with Donut, he pulls an angled, still-intact section of the redoubt from his inventory and puts it up as a shield; the clurichauns' slingshot rocks ping off the steel table, and a screaming tentacle slams it and rockets them both against the back wall. When he has sent a zombie off toward the door with a lit jug, he dives behind it again and pulls the alchemy table over the top to make a clamshell.
beats.gist: Carl hides behind a redoubt section and an alchemy table from Krakaren's tentacles.

beats.headline: A pyramid round the cat
beats.text: Donut will not wake, and Signet says she will remain where she is. When Carl lifts her anyway, a health bar appears and starts falling, and Signet tells him a water lily must not be removed, lest it die; he puts her back. Before he goes, he pulls the last of the redoubt pieces from his inventory, wood and metal, and erects an ugly, quick and dirty pyramid around the cat's chair. It won't protect her from a determined mob, but it is better than nothing. Mongo jumps to the top of it and looks down through the jagged hole.
beats.gist: Donut will not wake, so Carl leaves her in place and builds a rough pyramid around her chair.
